title: 장학금규정 / queue:ARTICLE:15:0:00015:part:1/1

Article 15 (Suspension of Payment and Recovery of Scholarships)
(1) Where a person who has become entitled to receive, or is receiving, a scholarship ceases during the period of payment to meet the grounds for payment under Article 4, violates an instruction issued under Article 8, or violates a matter determined under Article 9, scholarship payments shall be suspended immediately. <Amended on August 8, 1973.>
(2) In a case under paragraph (1), the Minister of Education or the Superintendent of Education of the Board of Education of Seoul Special Metropolitan City, Busan City or a Do, as applicable under Article 3 (1), shall require repayment of scholarships already paid: Provided, That all or part of the repayment may be waived for a person for whom unavoidable circumstances exist. <Amended on May 8, 1979; February 1, 1991; January 29, 2001; February 29, 2008; and March 23, 2013.>
